name: Force FPS
description: Runs Geometry Dash levels at a steady custom FPS on Android. Menus stay at normal FPS.

disable-vsync.name: Disable VSync
disable-vsync.description: Needed to go above your screen's refresh rate (90 Hz). Off = GD is capped at 90.

texture-quality.name: Texture quality
texture-quality.description: Lower texture quality to make loading and heavy levels lighter. High = GD's normal. Medium = 75% fewer pixels (closest to your 60%). Low = blurry. Restart GD after changing.
